source: MEASURED 2026-10-08: real SDK 2.71.0 + Node 22.22.3 real fetch (undici) against a local HTTP server, fake key (logs/stage-03/survey/probe-stream.mjs; output probe-stream.out). Error envelopes {detail:{type,code,message,status,request_id}} from https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/resources/errors (accessed 2026-10-08); values COMPOSED.
kind: thrown errors at the SDK boundary and from the body reader

detail.message: A voice with the voice_id VOICE_ID was not found.

httpErrorBeforeAudio.where: thrown by stream(...).withRawResponse() itself - before any chunk, exactly as for convert()

abortBeforeHeader.timerLeak: YES - the SDK's request timer is not cleared on a rejected fetch (core/fetcher/makeRequest.js): a child process with timeoutInSeconds 4 lived 4930 ms after a call that settled at 56 ms; with the default 240 s the process lived 241 s (logs/stage-03/survey/leak240.out; same leak as stage 2).

abortAfterHeaderMidBody.thrownBy: the reader of data (for await over the ReadableStream) - NOT the SDK
abortAfterHeaderMidBody.timerLeak: NO - the timer was cleared when the header arrived (makeRequest.js l.56-57): child process with the DEFAULT 240 s timeout exited 1780 ms after start (call done at 14 ms).

bodyLongerThanTimeout.meaning: the SDK timeout bounds only time-to-first-byte on /stream (and convert); a long streamed speech is not cut at 240 s

fixture.midStreamErrorEvent: NONE documented: /stream is raw chunked audio, there is no in-band error frame. A failure after the header can only show up as a broken/short body (GUESS: the vendor ends the body early or resets the connection; not documented).

expect.beforeFirstChunk: Same classes and statuses as speak today: coax's retry (isTransient on statusCode / lifted network code) and the ai-layer fallback apply.
expect.afterFirstChunk: The error comes from undici, not the SDK: DOMException AbortError when the caller's signal aborted, TypeError 'terminated' (cause code UND_ERR_SOCKET) when the connection dropped. Neither carries a status. character-cost was already read at the header -> O16: mark the failure with withBilledUsage({ characters }), and on abort throw a CoaxAbortError carrying it.
expect.billedWhenCutOff: NOT documented whether ElevenLabs bills the full character-cost of a generation the client abandoned. GUESS: yes (the header is sent before the audio, as the bill of the request).
